Package be.kdg.model

Class RaceBike

java.lang.Object
be.kdg.model.RaceBike
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<RaceBike>
public class RaceBike extends Object implements Comparable<RaceBike>
Represents a racing bicycle with comprehensive specifications and characteristics. This class models professional and amateur racing bikes with detailed technical information including brand, model, materials, components, and pricing.

Race bikes are uniquely identified by the combination of their brand and model. Two bikes with the same brand and model are considered equal, regardless of other attributes. The class implements natural ordering by brand first, then by model name.

All monetary values are stored as BigDecimal for precision, and the class provides comprehensive validation for all input parameters to ensure data integrity.

  • Constructor Details

    • RaceBike

      public RaceBike(Brand brand, String model, Color color, double weight, int frameSize, LocalDate releaseDate, BigDecimal price, Currency currency, Groupset groupset, FrameMaterial frameMaterial, ForkMaterial forkMaterial, BrakeType brakeType, WheelSize wheelSize)
      Creates a fully specified RaceBike with all technical details. This constructor allows for complete initialization of all bicycle specifications.
      Parameters:
      brand - the manufacturer brand (must not be null)
      model - the specific model name (must not be null or empty)
      color - the primary frame color
      weight - the total weight in kilograms (must be non-negative)
      frameSize - the frame size in centimeters (must be non-negative)
      releaseDate - the official release date (must not be null)
      price - the retail price (must not be negative)
      currency - the price currency
      groupset - the drivetrain groupset
      frameMaterial - the frame material composition
      forkMaterial - the fork material composition
      brakeType - the braking system type
      wheelSize - the wheel and tire size specification
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any validation constraint is violated

    • RaceBike

      public RaceBike(Brand brand, String model, Color color)
      Creates a RaceBike with basic specifications (brand, model, color). Other technical specifications are set to default values and can be updated later.
      Parameters:
      brand - the manufacturer brand (must not be null)
      model - the specific model name (must not be null or empty)
      color - the primary frame color
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if brand is null or model is null/empty

    • RaceBike

      public RaceBike(Brand brand, String model)
      Creates a RaceBike with minimal specifications (brand and model only). The color defaults to WHITE, and other specifications are set to default values.

      model - the specific model name (must not be null or empty)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if brand is null or model is null/empty
